pairs.evidence: src/i18n/__tests__/useTranslatedError.test.ts:25 The fixture claims a full `Translations` object but only fills `error_registry`. That is safe only because `resolveErrorTranslated` reads nothing but `t.error_registry` (src/i18n/useTranslatedError.ts:214). Neither the cast nor the resolver mentions this, so if the resolver starts reading another section, the cast still compiles and the test fails at runtime instead of type-checking.

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/__tests__/useTranslatedError.test.ts:25 Double cast past the checker. It is safe only because of what useTranslatedError.ts:214 reads, and neither the cast site nor that line says so.

src/i18n/__tests__/chainStopReasons.parity.test.ts:31 Applied by analogy. reason_token is a raw String that no type checks (comment at :9).
